Help

Input
Select a tuning, enable the microphone and pluck one open string at a time.
Tunings
Search by name or notes. Drag the left handle to reorder. Keyboard: focus the handle, then use arrow keys, Home or End.
Strings
Click to lock a string. Double-tap or double-click to hear its reference tone. Keyboard: Shift + Enter. Select Auto to resume automatic matching.
Pitch
Flat: tighten. Sharp: loosen. Green indicates the selected tolerance. One cent is 1/100 of a semitone.
Chromatic
Detects any note, without a preset string layout.
Bass & electric guitar
A direct audio interface often works better for low bass notes or an unamplified electric guitar.

Input pauses briefly during reference playback. Check string tension before large tuning changes.

If input is unavailable, allow desktop apps to access the microphone in Windows privacy settings. Permission help ↗
